headline: Unbiased describes Pareto 26.9 as a blended multi-model inference system
summary: Unbiased's September 17, 2026 product page describes Pareto 26.9 as a blended AI system that engages multiple frontier and open models in parallel and synthesizes their results for one response, rather than selecting a single model as a conventional router would. The provider publishes five benchmark scores for the release: DeepSWE 74, Terminal-Bench 4.0 51, MMMU-Pro 78, Humanity's Last Exam without tools 49, and ArXivMath 88. The provider states that it has not published measured task costs or a composite score for Pareto 26.9. The architecture and scores are provider-reported; they were not independently reproduced in this review.
